tool_calls.literal: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' README.md; jq -r '.stack_frames[] | select(startswith(\"action:\"))' samples.jsonl | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head -30; jq -r '[.value, (.stack_frames[] | select(startswith(\"action:\")))] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{s["'$2]+=$1; n[$2]++} END {for(k in s) print s[k],n[k],k}'"' | sort -nr | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.value, (.stack_frames[] | select(startswith(\"action:\")))] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '"'$2=="action:click" {if($1>0){p+=$1;pn++}else{n+=-$1;nn++}} END{printf "click bad=%d good=%d excess=%d ratio=%.3f tuples_bad=%d tuples_good=%d'"\\n\",p,n,p-n,p/n,pn,nn}'; jq -r '[.value, (.stack_frames[] | select(startswith(\"action:\")))] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$1>0)p+=$1;else n+=-$1} END{printf "all operations bad=%d good=%d ratio=%.3f'"\\n\",p,n,p/n}'; jq -r 'select(any(.stack_frames[]; .==\"action:click\")) | [.value,.labels.source_session[0]] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$1>0){bp[$2]=1}else{gp[$2]=1}} END{for(k in bp)b++;for(k in gp)g++;printf "sessions with clicks bad=%d good=%d'"\\n\",b,g}'"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.value, (.stack_frames[] | select(startswith(\"action:\")))] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '"'$2=="action:noop" {if($1>0)p+=$1;else n+=-$1} {if($1>0)ap+=$1;else an+=-$1} END{printf "noop bad=%d good=%d excess=%d raw_ratio=%.3f bad_share=%.3f%% good_share=%.3f%% share_ratio=%.3f'"\\n\",p,n,p-n,p/n,100*p/ap,100*n/an,(p/ap)/(n/an)}'; jq -r 'select(any(.stack_frames[]; .==\"action:noop\")) | [.value,.labels.source_session[0]] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$1>0)bp[$2]=1; else gp[$2]=1} END{for(k in bp)b++;for(k in gp)g++;printf "sessions containing noop: bad=%d good=%d'"\\n\",b,g}'; jq -r 'select(any(.stack_frames[]; .==\"action:noop\")) | [.value, (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith(\"result:\"))), (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith(\"object:\")))] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{k="'$2; if($1>0)p[k]+=$1; else n[k]+=-$1} END{for(k in p) printf "%d %d %+d %s'"\\n\",p[k],n[k],p[k]-n[k],k}' | sort -nr | head -20"
